current_baseline.why: Of the three frozen trial_0080 working points (th045 / v2 / v3) this one has BOTH the highest F1 (94.7469%) and the lowest false-alarm rate (0.02082 per frame, 30.6% below the 0.03 bound).  It supersedes th045 as THE baseline for all downstream work (spatio-temporal post-processing search, board port, delivery).
current_baseline.model: trial_0080 epoch3 = the source graph of the delivered p0_off_A_none.rknn (6,326,305 B, md5 1a3faf2f9459cad8a389ffa81810234c) -- the ONNX export hm_plain.onnx is the surviving stand-in for the deleted .pt
current_baseline.sky_ratio_note: sky_ratio=1.0 makes is_sky always true => th_ground never gates anything (it becomes a dead parameter) AND the salvage tier / hover exemption / sky-aware rigid pruning cover the WHOLE frame.  It is not merely 'one uniform threshold'.  th_deep=0.0 is dead in all three versions (the code only enables the deep band when th_deep > 0).

_provenance.only_changed_vs_v3: confirm_consec 7->2、confirm_gap_tol 0->6、max_age 3->10（由 max_age_phys=10 接管）、新增 r_slope=3.5、alpha_decay=1.0；match_dist 保持 16.0；其余全部沿用 v3。

confirm_consec.note: 以前要连续看到 6 次才认作真目标；低帧率下只要命中 2 次就快速起批确认。

confirm_gap_tol.note: 以前起批期间 1 帧都不能漏；现在允许中间跳过 6 个物理帧(240ms)，解决跳帧断链。

max_age_phys.note: 目标短暂跟丢后最多保留 10 个物理帧(400ms)，超时立刻销毁防幽灵框拖尾。

r_slope.note: 每多跳 1 帧，目标搜索匹配半径自动放宽 3.5 px，防止飞太快出圈跟丢。

match_dist.note: 基础匹配半径保持保守不变（实测在 24 条视频上最稳）。

offline_semantics.dt_equals_1_offline: 本 OSD 是 25fps **逐帧**离线评测 ⇒ 每一次调用都是 Δn=1 ⇒ r_slope*(dt-1)=0 ⇒ r_slope 在离线里是 no-op；alpha_decay=1.0 也是 no-op（保持 legacy 打分规则）。这两项只在板端跳帧(Δn>1)时才起作用。
offline_semantics.max_age_phys_takes_over: max_age_phys=10 一旦非空，Python 侧改用 (frame_idx - last_hit_fid) > 10 判死（eval_bidirectional_track_fusion.py:311-312），替代原来的 max_age(调用次数)=3。
offline_semantics.confirm_gap_tol: 确认段允许 max_gap = 1 + confirm_gap_tol = 7 帧的间隔（system_sota_longquan.py:380-382）。
